title: The Setting From Last Time: What a Station Keeps Between Runs, What It Reads Back, and Files Written by an Older Version
fallback: This lesson is about the file a program keeps its settings in, so it needs Qt. Lesson 03-15 is about a number written down and read back in plain C++, and lesson 04-12 about a configuration that does not say what you think. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: the settings of a control station, read back with a default and a note for a value that is not usable, written when asked, and migrated from the first version of the file
